mechanics.reason: Building pass 2026-11-22 (owner decision: build now): own row Build_Grotto (banks carrier, no native bonus, HotA cost 7500 Gold, 15 Wood, 15 Ore, needs Market). Homm3CoveGrottoRuntime and Homm3CoveGrottoWindow open an exchange window from a town-screen Grotto button: a visiting (else garrison) hero sacrifices creatures for floor(squadValue / 40) x 5 experience each (HoMM3 Altar of Sacrifice formula on OE squadValue) and keeps at least one creature. Substituted because the HotA artifact sacrifice is not offered: the plugin has no save-safe native artifact removal.

Building pass 2026-11-22: the grail keeps its HumanGraal extras (1000 Gold + 1 of each resource daily, +100% city growth; owner answer 3) and adds the HotA clause 'all terrain counts as native' as the native anyLandEqualNativeLandBonus graal side bonus (Unfrozen law 34's bonus). Homm3CoveLodestarRuntime forces the battle side and stack native flags at battle start for a side owning a Lodestar, because static evidence shows the native bonus reaches the creature check but not the side flag. Applies to the whole army: OE has no per-faction native qualifier.

Current skill design is the buried-treasure hunt (docs/cove_treasure_hunting_design.md): every rank grants only the 0-mana Dig spell, map pieces and treasure sites are plugin state, and the picks are runtime-driven. The earlier Groundsight variants and the Plunder chest/mine bonuses are retired, as is the unstable Cannon support stack.
